overview.summary: 本视频从以太网和IEEE 802.3的技术标准出发，探讨了双脚线和光纤的支持方式；接着深入到交换机和路由器的MAC地址及其在网络中的作用；通过发送单播和广播帧的例子展示了交换机如何隔离冲突域；最后总结了以太网的工作组和物理层的相关知识。

了解交换机如何隔离冲突域
认识以太网的工作组和物理层

overview.summary_en: This chapter begins with the technical standards of Ethernet and IEEE 802.3, discussing the support for twisted pair and fiber optics. It then delves into the MAC addresses of switches and routers and their roles in the network. Through examples of sending unicast and broadcast frames, it illustrates how switches isolate collision domains. Finally, it summarizes the knowledge related to the Ethernet工作组 and physical layer.
takeaways_en: Understand Ethernet and IEEE 802.3 technical standards
Master the MAC address functions of switches and routers
Familiarize yourself with the transmission mechanisms of unicast and broadcast frames in Ethernet
Understand how switches isolate collision domains
Recognize the Ethernet工作组and physical layers
